==Description ==
The '''Sock Puppet''' is a fast enemy that appears in [[Pizza Party]]. It has a fast speed, faster than all enemies that appeared before it, high amount of health and decent defense.

== Appearance ==
The '''Sock Puppet''' is a large sock puppet that is mounted on six mechanical legs. The sock puppet itself is an orange sock with black stripes, eyes and a mouth with white teeth and a tongue dangling out of it. Upon death, it makes a hissing noise, thus the sock resembled a snake.

==Strategy==
*High DPS towers, like the [[Ranger]], [[Pursuit]], [[Accelerator]] or [[Golden Minigunner]] are recommended.
**The [[Commander]] and [[DJ Booth]] can be very useful at boosting the firerate and range of your towers.
*Stalling towers such as the [[Archer]] can be quite useful against this, due to its very fast speed.
**As it has no immunities, any form of stalling can be used effectively.
**Its lack of immunities means that some of the stalling towers, like the [[Freezer]], can also be used to drop its defense.
